subject: english
title: The Sentence
objective: Recognise and use the sentence correctly.

lesson.opening: “Patient effort” names what is spoken of. “Removes mountains” says something about that subject.

sections.heading: The Sentence
sections.body: “Patient effort” names what is spoken of. “Removes mountains” says something about that subject.

activities.prompt: In “Patient effort removes mountains,” which words form the complete subject?
In your own words, explain the rule behind “The Sentence”, with one example.
